chatMessages.question: What is the governing law of this contract?
chatMessages.answerText: The governing law of this contract is the laws of The Republic of Ireland. This is stated in Contract Excerpt 2, Clause 26: "This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of The Republic of Ireland."
